Definition: from G1537 and G2860; to escape by swimming:--swim out.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to escape by swimming out, and it occurs once, in the shipwreck that carried Paul to Malta. The soldiers want to kill the prisoners so none can swim away and escape, but the centurion stops them, and those who can swim cast themselves first into the sea and get to land. The word is the sound of men swimming for their lives in a storm.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God saves through the storm, not only from it, because the ship broke apart and yet every soul reached the shore.
